## 更新 · What's new

- 修复手机与 Mac 之间的中继连接每隔几秒反复断开重连的问题：系统分享页发送文本时，Mac 实际已收到，手机却一直提示发送失败，同一条内容在 Mac 上还会重复入库。网络探测不再自我循环触发，会话传输数据期间不会因心跳晚到被误关，中继链路的判定时间也相应放宽。
  Fixed relay connections between phone and Mac dropping and reconnecting every few seconds: text sent from the system share sheet reached the Mac but the phone kept reporting failure, and the same item was added to Mac history repeatedly. Network probes no longer re-trigger themselves, sessions busy transferring data are no longer closed over a late heartbeat, and relay links get a longer grace window.
- 同步日志会记录每次连接断开的原因、连接时长和最后响应时间，方便排查连接问题。
  Sync logs now record why each connection closed, how long it lasted and when the peer last responded, to make connection issues easier to diagnose.
- Mac：新增设备组命令行 `ClipyClone --relay-cli`，可在本机终端查看状态、发出邀请或用邀请链接加入设备组，适合无人值守的设备。
  Mac: added the device-group command line `ClipyClone --relay-cli` to check status, send invitations or join with an invite link from a local terminal, for unattended machines.
